label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa contra gentiles I.42: A thing has being in the manner it possesses unity; if…
interpretation: The conclusion concerns INTERNAL unity of the divine nature, not directly the number of externally distinct roots. The being/unity-power proportionality and maximum-unity-to-no-internal-plurality steps remain source commitments. Do not infer common numerical nature across candidates or deny distinct divine persons by substituting their domain for essential composition.
